cohort_definition_drafts.title: New-onset hypertension cohort (study group)
cohort_definition_drafts.description: Adults >18 years with newly recorded hypertension diagnosis per US guidelines (SBP >130 or DBP >80 on two consecutive measurements), no prior cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease, no abnormal kidney function, no thyroid disease, and no prior antihypertensive medication use.
cohort_definition_drafts.entry_event: First recorded HTN diagnosis preceded by ≥2 consecutive BP measurements with SBP >130 or DBP >80 within prior 2 years
cohort_definition_drafts.exit_strategy: End of continuous observation, death, or end of study follow-up

cohort_definition_drafts.title: Adults with ≥2 recorded BPs (denominator for prevalence)
cohort_definition_drafts.description: All patients >18 years of age with a minimum of 2 recorded blood pressures within the preceding 2 years.
cohort_definition_drafts.entry_event: Second recorded BP measurement within 2-year window

cohort_definition_drafts.title: Elevated BP without HTN diagnosis
cohort_definition_drafts.description: Patients with two consecutive recordings SBP >130 or DBP >80 (Stage 1+ HTN by readings) prior to any HTN diagnosis entry.
cohort_definition_drafts.exit_strategy: Recorded HTN diagnosis, end of observation, or death

cohort_definition_drafts.title: Treatment-resistant hypertension
cohort_definition_drafts.description: Treated hypertensive patients with persistently elevated BP despite use of 3 or more antihypertensive agents.
cohort_definition_drafts.entry_event: Concurrent prescription of ≥3 antihypertensive drug classes with persistently elevated BP
cohort_definition_drafts.exit_strategy: BP control achieved, end of observation, or death

cohort_definition_drafts.title: Renal sympathetic denervation recipients
cohort_definition_drafts.description: Patients undergoing renal nerve ablation procedures for hypertension.
cohort_definition_drafts.exit_strategy: End of follow-up, with BP recorded at 1, 3, 6, and 12 months post-procedure

cohort_definition_drafts.title: Age- and gender-matched non-hypertensive controls
cohort_definition_drafts.description: Adults >18 years without recorded hypertension diagnosis or elevated BP readings, matched on age and gender to the hypertensive cohort.
cohort_definition_drafts.entry_event: Index date matched to HTN cohort entry
cohort_definition_drafts.exit_strategy: HTN diagnosis, end of observation, or death

cohort_definition_drafts.title: Cardiovascular/cerebrovascular outcome cohort
cohort_definition_drafts.description: First occurrence of myocardial infarction, heart failure, stroke, or cardiovascular death following index.
cohort_definition_drafts.entry_event: First qualifying CV/cerebrovascular diagnosis or death
